constrained_search.statement: No single threshold satisfies both the 0.80 abstain-precision constraint and a dev abstain recall of 0.9898: the highest recall attainable by any precision-compliant single threshold is 0.9756, below the band's 0.9898. degenerate_check.note: In the frozen run single_matched_recall.t == band.t_lo (degenerate: only the upper cut can differ). In the corrected run this equality does NOT hold, so the construction is not degenerate in that sense; the matched threshold sits above the band's upper threshold instead.
